core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fuzail corresponds to the Arabic form فُضَيل (Arabic root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l); فُضَيل (Fuḍayl)). Its core sense is diminutive of faḍl; excellent, virtuous. Fuzail (فُضَيل, Fuḍayl) is the diminutive of فَضْل (faḍl) 'excellence, virtue', from the root f-ḍ-l. It was borne by the early ascetic Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ. The source gloss 'pious, God-fearing' reflects the religious reputation of that bearer rather than the lexical sense, which is 'little excellence, of virtue'.
